name: Premier Umalas 16 — Stylish 3BR Pool Townhouse
description:
Stylish 3-bedroom townhouse with private pool in quiet Umalas, 10 min to the beach by scooter. Modern tropical design, peaceful street, great cafes nearby. 140 m2 with three balcony bedrooms, Wi-Fi 200 Mbps, workspaces, Smart TV and fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for families, groups, digital nomads and long stays.

This spacious 140 m2 townhouse spans two floors and is designed for comfortable Bali living — combining coziness, privacy and modern tropical design. On the upper floor are three bright suite bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and balcony. On the ground floor, the living room opens directly to the fully private pool. The house is fully air-conditioned and suits both short holidays and long-term stays.

What's included: private pool, fast Wi-Fi 200 Mbps, comfortable workspaces for remote work, Smart TV (Netflix, Apple TV, YouTube — use your own account), fully equipped kitchen with stove, microwave, coffee machine, blender and kettle, washing machine, safe, iron and ironing board.

name: Premier Umalas 17 — Stylish 2BR Private Pool Home
description:
Stylish 2-bedroom townhouse with a private pool in peaceful Umalas, just 10 minutes from the beach by scooter. Modern tropical design, a quiet street, and great cafes and restaurants nearby create the perfect atmosphere for enjoying Bali. The spacious 100 sqm home features two bedrooms with balconies, fast 200 Mbps Wi-Fi, two comfortable workspaces, Smart TV, and a fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for couples, digital nomads, families, and long stays.

This spacious 100 sqm townhouse is spread over two floors and designed for comfortable Bali living, combining privacy, relaxation, and modern tropical design. Upstairs you will find two bright bedroom suites, each with its own private balcony and en-suite bathroom. The living area downstairs opens directly onto the private swimming pool. The house is fully air-conditioned and ideal for both short stays and long-term living.

name: Villa Black Pool — Family 4BR Villa with Big Pool
description:
Villa Black Pool is a spacious, modern 4-bedroom villa featuring a stunning private black-tiled pool, lush tropical garden, and stylish open-plan design. Located in a peaceful corner of Sanur, it combines privacy with convenience — just a short walk to the beach, cafes, and shops.

Bedrooms: 4 private bedrooms with A/C, blackout curtains, and garden views; soft linens, fresh towels, and quality mattresses. Each of the 4 bedrooms has a private en-suite bathroom, plus a refreshing outdoor shower by the pool. Fully equipped kitchen with stove, fridge, water filter, and utensils; coffee, tea, and cooking essentials provided. Large open living room with comfortable lounge area and pool view, indoor dining space and shaded outdoor terrace.

Housekeeping 2x a week, bed linens changed every 5 days, pool and garden maintenance 2x a week. High-speed fiber Wi-Fi (300 Mbps) and a work-friendly desk setup — ideal for remote work. Walking distance to Sanur beach, yoga studios, massage spots, and restaurants. Safe, calm area with easy access to Renon, Seminyak, and the airport.
